run_ui_detect_cli: run the ui_detect CLI to detect UI elements in a screenshot image using YOLO
run_ui_detect_with_ocr: run the ui_detect CLI to detect UI elements and recognize text via OCR in a screenshot
run_ui_detect_save_visualization: run the ui_detect CLI to detect UI elements and save a visualized output image with bounding boxes
run_ui_detect_export_json: run the ui_detect CLI to detect UI elements and export results as a JSON file
run_ui_detect_custom_threshold: run the ui_detect CLI with a custom confidence threshold for UI element detection
